blazers.pulse: Portland is 2-0 after a blowout of the Suns and a shaky 128-120 win in Sacramento, so the vibe is good. The worry is health: Scoot is questionable with a sore ankle for tonight's game at the 3-0 Lakers.
storylines: Avdija led the Kings win with 26; Lillard and Camara added 19 each
Nori admitted the team lost its composure late in Sacramento, himself included
Scoot Henderson questionable vs. Lakers (left ankle soreness)
Branden Carlson questionable, in concussion protocol; Shaedon Sharpe out (meniscus)
Next up: at the Lakers, Tuesday 8 p.m. PT

timbers.pulse: Aravena's 96th-minute header beat Charlotte 3-2 and snapped a seven-game winless run. It keeps Portland alive, but they're still chasing the last West playoff spot and need help from other results.
storylines: Lassiter brace, two Izoita assists, Aravena winner at 90+6
Still three points back of the final West playoff spot, needing other results to go their way
Diego Chara to retire after the 2027 Sprint Season

f1.pulse: Antonelli won Austin for his ninth win of the year and now leads by 123 with five races left. Ninth or better in Mexico this Sunday makes him champion, so everyone's waiting on the coronation.
storylines: Antonelli on 365 points, 123 clear of Russell and 124 of Hamilton
Mexico City GP Nov. 1: top nine clinches it, or he clinches if neither Russell nor Hamilton wins
Russell called his Austin track-limits penalty 'a bit ridiculous' after dropping to eighth
Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds could still be cancelled over the US-Iran war (per ESPN)
